changelog: Wording fix: remove city- and brand-specific references (municipality notices phrased generically, generic trip examples). No behavioral changes.
summary: Daily triage of Wilma school notifications for Finnish parents. Fetches exams, messages, news, schedules, homework, and lesson notes (merkinnät) — filters for actionable items, downloads and reads important bulletin attachments, syncs exams to Google Calendar, and reports via chat. Requires the `wilma` skill and `gog` CLI (or `gog` skill from ClawHub) for calendar access.
